stations.title: Dilys
stations.say: Can the shop look like our window?
stations.note: This week's firing came out well.

stations.title: The shop
stations.text: Six pot cards stand in one long column.

captions: Dilys wants the shop to look like the shelves in the studio window.
The pots stand in one long column, so the bowls are far down the page.
You make the classes and the shelf grids, with columns, a gap, repeat() and minmax().
The bowls stand on the shelf in a row with other pots, the way they do in the window.
Same pots, same words. Now the shop has rows, and it fits any screen.
